services.title: Practical support for stronger mosque governance.
services.summary: Training, policies, risk support and management guidance built around the day-to-day realities of mosque leadership.
intro: Faith Associates has worked with mosque trustees, staff and volunteers for more than two decades. Our support combines sector knowledge with practical tools that leadership teams can implement.
Programmes can be delivered as focused masterclasses, organisational reviews or longer development partnerships shaped around the institution’s priorities.

highlights.title: Management & governance
highlights.body: One- and two-day masterclasses for trustees and leaders covering governance, accountability, finance and community service.

highlights.title: Policies & procedures

highlights.title: Risk & resilience

highlights.title: Election management
highlights.body: Independent support for voter registration, election planning, secure voting, monitoring and transparent results.

services.title: Safer learning. Better-run institutions.
services.summary: Governance, safeguarding and teaching support for madrassahs, maktabs and supplementary schools.
intro: Faith Associates understands the pressures placed on madrassah leaders, teachers and volunteers. Our work helps institutions put consistent management and safeguarding arrangements around the learning experience.
Support is grounded in the Madrassah Management and Safeguarding framework and years of work with supplementary schools across the UK and internationally.

highlights.title: Governance review
highlights.body: Structures, responsibilities, policies and reporting lines that support accountable leadership.

highlights.title: Safeguarding practice
highlights.body: Child protection training, safer recruitment, disclosure handling and practical audit support.

highlights.title: Staff development
highlights.body: Training for teachers, administrators and volunteers on their operational and safeguarding duties.

highlights.title: Quality framework
highlights.body: Support across admission, curriculum, teaching practice, assessment and continuous improvement.

outcomes: Safer provision for children and young people

services.title: Leadership support for a changing context.

intro: Imams are trusted grassroots leaders. Faith Associates complements theological expertise with training in leadership, communication, safeguarding and institutional development.
Through Imams Online and international partnerships, we help leaders share good practice and engage confidently with contemporary community needs.

highlights.title: Leadership development
highlights.body: Practical management, public leadership and community engagement skills for faith leaders.

services.title: Turn complex institutional challenges into clear action.

highlights.title: Level 1 training
highlights.body: Introduction-level safeguarding for staff, teachers, managers, administrators and volunteers.

Workshops and presentations are delivered by mosque management and legal-compliance specialists, with materials leaders can take back and use immediately.

serviceOfferings.title: Safer Recruitment Training
serviceOfferings.summary: Help mosque and madrassah teams hire managers, teachers, administrators and volunteers using safer, more consistent recruitment practice.
intro: Safer Recruitment training supports institutions to employ the best candidates while protecting children, adults at risk and the organisation itself.
It is essential for anyone responsible for hiring — whether for paid roles or volunteer positions.
The training helps mosque, madrassah and centre teams follow consistent procedures so the safety of students, staff and the wider institution is treated as a core recruitment responsibility.

highlights.title: Safer processes
highlights.body: Practical steps for advertising, shortlisting, interviewing and appointment.

highlights.title: Checks & references
highlights.body: How to handle disclosures, references and suitability decisions consistently.

highlights.body: Clear expectations for managers, teachers, administrators, trustees and volunteers involved in recruitment.

highlights.title: Institutional protection
highlights.body: Reduce avoidable risk while building a capable, trusted workforce around children and adults at risk.

serviceOfferings.title: First Aid Training for Mosques and Madrassahs
serviceOfferings.summary: Certified first aid training that keeps staff and volunteers prepared for emergencies as part of wider health and safety requirements.
intro: Faith Associates offers certified First Aid training for mosques and madrassahs, helping teams respond confidently when someone is injured or becomes ill.
Courses can be tailored to institutional needs, including Emergency First Aid at Work and Paediatric First Aid pathways.

highlights.title: Paediatric First Aid

highlights.title: Faith-setting delivery
highlights.body: Training shaped around the realities of mosques, madrassahs and busy community venues.

serviceOfferings.summary: Practical security awareness for mosque buildings and congregations — how to prevent harm and how to respond if an incident occurs.
intro: Mosque Security Training outlines the risks your building and congregation may face, how to protect yourselves against them, and how to react to minimise harm if they occur.
The training is designed for trustees, staff and volunteers who need proportionate, practical security awareness — not fear-driven overreaction.

intro: Martyn’s Law is designed to ensure that public venues, events and community spaces are better prepared for the threat of terrorism.
Faith Associates helps mosque and community leaders understand what the legislation means in practice and how to put proportionate protective measures in place.

highlights.body: What Martyn’s Law / Protect Duty expects from premises and organisers.

A 5* Beacon Mosque combines spiritual purpose with efficient, inclusive and sustainable services for the whole community.

This one-day course strengthens understanding of abuse and safeguarding risks, how to refer concerns, and what happens after a referral.

intro: This programme enhances knowledge of protecting children and vulnerable people in Islamic institutions, recognising warning signs and taking the right action.

highlights.title: Practical application

It is designed for leaders and staff who work directly with children, young people and families.

highlights.title: Core topics
highlights.body: Safeguarding in Islam, national agenda, definitions of abuse and disclosure practice.

highlights.title: Complex risks

highlights.title: Roles & responsibilities
highlights.body: Clear expectations inside mosques and supplementary schools.

highlights.body: Accredited trainers and materials to review annually.

serviceOfferings.summary: A two-day intensive course for madrassah and supplementary-school teachers covering pedagogy, behaviour, planning and safeguarding.
intro: Being a madrassah or supplementary-school teacher is demanding. This course gives practical knowledge teachers can apply immediately to improve professionalism, effectiveness and pupils’ learning experience.
It is designed for teachers and assistants working with children aged 5–17.

highlights.title: Classroom practice
highlights.body: Positive classroom context, expectations, lesson structures and learning behaviours.

highlights.title: Behaviour & relationships
highlights.body: Motivation, behaviour responses, class agreements and building positive relationships.

highlights.body: National safeguarding agenda awareness for teaching staff.

serviceOfferings.summary: Chaplaincy skills for imams working in hospitals, prisons, schools and multi-faith institutional settings.
intro: This course is for imams who want to develop chaplaincy skills — supporting spiritual and pastoral needs while working closely with people of other faiths or no faith.
Chaplains may work in settings such as the NHS, HM prisons and schools, and need a philosophy of practice suited to those contexts.

highlights.title: Institutional chaplaincy
highlights.body: Manage the challenge of being a religious representative in hospitals and education settings.

highlights.title: Multi-faith practice
highlights.body: Critical reflection on working with other faiths and people of no faith.

highlights.title: Personal philosophy

highlights.title: On-site delivery
highlights.body: Expert trainers deliver bespoke materials at your chosen venue.

serviceOfferings.title: Muslim Digital Safety Ambassadors Programme

Supported by partners including Google and the London Mayor’s Office, the programme focuses on online safety, mental health and peer-to-peer support.
